Allentown, PA – September 8, 2026 – Red Robin on Airport Road in Allentown, PA is bringing neighbors, families, guests and local organizations together for Community Week, a seven-day celebration focused on community connection, kid-friendly entertainment and giving back to local causes.

The event will run Monday, September 21 through Sunday, September 27 at Red Robin Airport Road, located at 1875 Airport Road in Allentown, PA.
